patents.title: Reconfigurable Fault Injection Board for Automotive ECU I/O Lines with Solid-State Relay Matrix and Microcontroller Interface
patents.abstract: A hardware board comprising a matrix of solid-state relays arranged to selectively connect any of up to 32 ECU I/O lines to open-circuit, battery voltage, or ground conditions under software control. A microcontroller receives fault commands over a standard serial interface and drives the relay gates within a guaranteed 2 ms switching latency. The board includes overcurrent protection on each channel and a watchdog that returns all channels to a safe default state if the host controller fails to send a heartbeat within a configurable timeout. The design targets low-cost laboratory HiL bench applications.
